claims.evidence: The witness only reports a generic front headlight assembly with an amber/orange indicator section; no readable brand/model/part number or vehicle-compatibility markings were captured.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk (Accord 2003 vs 2007, and left/right fitment) — the witness did not confirm the exact side or vehicle model markings.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of any part number/label on the headlamp housing (e.g., sticker/engraving) plus a shot showing the mounting side/retainer tabs clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used headlamp assembly with unknown fitment (worst-case: may not match Accord 2003/2007 or may be the wrong side).

risks.risk: Condition risk (cracks, chips, lens cloudiness, moisture/condensation inside the lens) — not visible clearly in the report.
risks.proof: A straight-on close-up of the lens surface and a side-angle shot showing the inside of the lens for any haze/moisture, plus a clip showing the lens under light.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially worn/uncertain condition (worst-case: lens damage or moisture present).

risks.risk: Functionality risk (bulb/ballast/igniter included and working) — the report does not show bulbs or test status.
risks.proof: A short video powering the headlight (or showing included bulbs/ballast/igniter) and confirming it lights properly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untested/unknown working status (worst-case: needs bulbs/repairs).

risks.risk: Missing parts / mounting hardware risk (broken tabs/retainers, missing wiring connector/harness) — not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of all mounting points/retainer tabs and the back connector area, showing whether the connector and wiring/harness are present and intact.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown mounting integrity (worst-case: missing tabs or connector).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the headlamp housing part number/label (sticker/engraving) and any brand markings.
Confirm which side it is (left or right) with a photo showing the mounting/retainer side.
Provide close-ups of the lens for cracks/chips/cloudiness and a view of the inside for moisture/condensation.
Show the back connector area and mounting tabs/retainers to confirm nothing is broken and the connector is included.
If possible, send a short video test showing the headlight turns on (and what components are included).
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a front headlamp assembly, so it can be priced at its worst-case as a used, unverified-fit headlight with unknown condition and functionality. Seller compatibility (Accord 2003/2007) is not confirmed by readable markings in the report.
